sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/sun-retreats-estero-bay (Campspot park record and site-type availability API, park 960, 1 night 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-12, 2 adults; read in a browser)
https://www.sunoutdoors.com/florida/sun-retreats-estero-bay (refused plain HTTP: 'You don't have permission to access')

hookups.source: Campspot site types for park 960 (every RV type: 'full hookups with 30- or 50-amp electric', amenities '30-Amp', '50-Amp', 'Water Hook-Up', 'Sewer Hook-Up'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 300 RV sites on 30 acres. Standard (grass or crushed-shell pad), Deluxe concrete, paver and lakefront sites are back-in; Premium sites are pull-through. Every RV type 'can accommodate up to 45 feet'. Park-model rentals are for annual guests.

sites.source: Campspot park 960 description ('our gorgeous all-age resort sits on 30 acres with 300 RV sites with full hook-ups and concrete pads') + site-type descriptions ('can accommodate up to 45 feet', 'These pull-through sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Heated pool, hot tub, clubhouse, dog park, playground, fishing in the two lakes, boardwalk and nature trail.

facilities.source: Campspot park 960 (park features 'Laundry', 'Internet Access', 'Pool', 'Hot Tub / Sauna', 'Clubhouse'; description 'heated pool', 'hot tub', 'fishing in our two lakes', 'boardwalk and nature trail'; RV site types list 'Wi-Fi'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: One-night stays sell on Campspot in November and January (Standard, Deluxe and Premium RV types available for 1 night on 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-12; the lakefront type was sold out both nights). Park-model rentals take a 7-night minimum. Stays under 30 nights: cancel 14+ days ahead for a refund.

booking.source: Campspot availability API for park 960, 2026-11-10 to 11-11 and 2027-01-12 to 01-13 (RV types 'AVAILABLE'; Park Model 'There is a 7 night minimum over the requested period of time') + cancellation policy, read 2026-10-21

summary: Campspot park record and 1-night availability: confirmed full hookups, 45-ft max, pull-throughs and Campspot booking; added 50-amp, 300 sites, laundry/Wi-Fi, one-night RV stays sold in Nov and Jan. Fees left as recorded 2026-10-13 (Campspot's current list prices are $103-115 in Nov 2026 and $113-132 in Jan 2027 before fees). Not confirmed: the note's 28-night winter minimum on pond-front sites (the lakefront type showed 'no campsites available', not a minimum rule) - kept.
flags: Fort Myers exception (no price gate): nightly RV stays are really for sale on Campspot in winter and fall, rigs to 45 ft, all-ages - nothing turns away a 23-ft Class C. Park-model rentals are 'available to annual guests' (7-night minimum) but RV sites dominate.

Operator website https://www.sunoutdoors.com/florida/sun-retreats-estero-bay refuses plain HTTP (Akamai 'You don't have permission'); not checked in a browser. Campspot's own record points its marketingSite at a different resort (woodsmoke-camping-resort) - a Campspot data error, not ours.
